notes.craft: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-11): Sperry documents how its boat shoe is made (handsewn moccasin, rawhide laces, razor-cut siped sole) and dates its founding and sole patent (1935, 1939), but names no factory, maker or tannery. Only one style (the $395 Made in Maine 2-Eye, 4 colourways, marked down) states a country, and the about page's "Handcrafted in Maine" for Gold Cup appears in no Gold Cup product copy in the feed. craft_evidence.owned: claim only: about page says Gold Cup shoes are "Handcrafted in Maine"; no factory named or shown; site run by licensee Aldo, IP owned by Authentic Brands Group
craft_evidence.makers: no: no PDP or page names a factory or maker
craft_evidence.mills: no: no tannery or leather supplier named ("certified leather" badge, certifier not named on PDP)
craft_evidence.madein: 4 of 678 footwear products (1 style, Authentic Original Made in Maine 2-Eye Boat Shoe, 4 colourways) state a country in feed copy; 0 of 3 rendered men's PDPs read (Harbor Loafer, Gold Cup Woven Penny Loafer, Harpoon Crush) state one
craft_evidence.heritage: dated, not placed: about page dates the founding to 1935 (Paul Sperry), the non-slip sole patent to 1939 and US Navy adoption to 1940; no town named
craft_evidence.process: partial: traditional moccasin construction, handsewn Authentic Original boat shoe, rawhide laces (50 products), razor-cut Wave-Siping outsole; no place or maker attached
craft_evidence.reasoning: Sperry documents how its boat shoe is made (handsewn moccasin, rawhide laces, razor-cut siped sole) and dates its founding and sole patent (1935, 1939), but names no factory, maker or tannery. Only one style (the $395 Made in Maine 2-Eye, 4 colourways, marked down) states a country, and the about page's "Handcrafted in Maine" for Gold Cup appears in no Gold Cup product copy in the feed. An unnamed Maine workshop is a claim, not evidence.

ownership.owner: Authentic Brands Group, LLC, via SR Holdings Inc. and Sperry Top-Sider, LLC (privacy policy eff. 23 Sep 2026; terms name them as trademark owners); site and stores operated by The Aldo Group Inc., Montreal (terms of service, footer)
